shadows.name: command-dock
shadows.purpose: Separate the floating dock from content beneath it.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Button background/border and input border transitions; --duration-fast.

motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: Meter width and scoped host-inspector View Transitions; --duration-normal. Snapshot overlays pass pointer events through; mobile, unsupported browsers and reduced motion update immediately.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove transitions and animations; restore automatic scrolling.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Button variant primary; native focus, hover, active, disabled and busy states.

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Default Button variant for supporting actions.

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: Low-emphasis Button variant, including dismissal actions.

components.name: Danger button
components.description: Explicit danger action variant; not an automatic remediation control.

components.name: Labeled input
components.description: Field plus Input; callers own label, description and invalid-state associations.
components.html: Synthetic example; no settings saved.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:var(--space-2);min-width:0;color:var(--color-text);font:400 var(--text-base)/1.5 var(--font-sans)}.ds-field label{font-weight:600}.ds-field p{margin:0;color:var(--color-text-muted);font-size:var(--text-sm)}.ds-input{width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:42px;padding:var(--space-2) var(--space-3);border:1px solid var(--color-border-strong);border-radius:var(--radius-sm);background:var(--color-input);color:var(--color-text);font:400 var(--text-base)/1.5 var(--font-sans);caret-color:var(--color-accent);transition:border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out)}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--color-text-muted);opacity:1}.ds-input:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:var(--color-text-muted)}.ds-input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--color-accent);outline:2px solid var(--color-accent);outline-offset:3px}.ds-input[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--color-danger)}.ds-input:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-input{transition:none}}

narrative.overview: Threshold-first operations in the Pencil Monochrome workspace. Graphite surfaces, Geist and neutral actions emphasize real measurements and configured limits. Amber and rose identify only semantic risk. Production views never substitute illustrative host or endpoint data.
keyCharacteristics: Geist for interface text, Geist Mono for values and identifiers.
Labeled risk, measured headroom and independently scoped endpoint status.
Workspace header, bottom command dock and keyboard search.
Incident evidence, AI hypotheses and confirmed resolutions are visually distinct.

rules.name: The Evidence Rule
rules.body: Keep observations, AI hypotheses and human-confirmed resolution explicitly labeled; color alone is not provenance.

rules.name: The Independent Signals Rule
rules.body: An online agent or running process does not establish endpoint reachability; a failed endpoint does not establish host failure or root cause.

rules.name: Independent Data States
rules.body: The admin session is checked through /api/auth/me independently of incident reads. Incident failures leave host monitoring available, never present unavailable counts as zero, and label retained records as cached. Successful recovery clears only that source's error.

rules.name: Touch Targets
rules.body: Shared controls use 44px minimum targets at widths of 700px and below or with a coarse pointer; the dock keeps text labels and does not widen the page.

dos: Do use shared native primitives and live CSS custom properties.
Do label measured evidence, AI hypotheses and human-confirmed resolution separately.
Do preserve visible focus, descriptive field errors and reduced-motion behavior.
Do show missing measurements as unavailable rather than zero.
Do keep host connectivity, process state and endpoint reachability independently labeled.
donts: Don't use color alone to communicate status or provenance.
Don't add decorative shadows, gradients or a competing token palette.
Don't present catalog examples as live telemetry or persisted configuration.
Don't assume Field or Notice supplies accessibility attributes that callers must set.
Don't infer reachability or root cause from a running process, high CPU or overlapping timestamps.
Don't pass screenshot data, example thresholds or planned controls off as live behavior.
